title: Rigid Rear-Dump Haul Truck (~90 t payload class, mechanical drive)

flow.title: Material path: body → tail chute → hopper / ROM pad
flow.description: The bauxite slides over the tail chute when the body passes about 23–25°.

power.title: Power flow: engine → torque converter → transmission → differential → final drives
power.description: Diesel power passes through the torque converter (which multiplies torque when starting on a grade) into the planetary powershift transmission, down the drive shaft to the rear differential and out to the planetary final drives in each rear wheel, which multiply torque again (about 4.8 : 1). Only the rear duals are driven; the front wheels steer.

summary: A rigid-frame rear-dump haul truck carries run-of-mine bauxite from the excavator face to the primary sizing station or the ROM pad. This ~90 t payload class (≈ 163 t gross) is mechanical drive: a ~750 kW V12 diesel drives the rear duals through a torque converter, a 7-speed planetary powershift transmission, a differential and planetary final drives. Two telescopic hoist cylinders tip the body to about 45–50° to dump in roughly 12–15 s.

model_configuration.animation: Dump cycle in real time (30 s): body raises to ~48° in ~13.5 s, payload slides from ~23°, body lowers in ~10 s

parts.name: Main Frame (box-section rails, cross-members, front bumper, body pivot horns)
Front Wheels: 27.00R49-class radial OTR tyres on five-piece rims (steer)
Rear Dual Wheels (driven): 4 tyres on five-piece rims
Suspension (nitrogen-over-oil struts, rear A-frame) & Steering Cylinders

Torque Converter, 7-speed Planetary Powershift Transmission & Drive Shaft
Rear Axle: Differential, Oil-Cooled Multi-Disc Brakes & Planetary Final Drives

ht_frame.function: Carries every load: engine, cab, body and payload, and transmits them to the axles.
ht_frame.construction: Two deep box-section rails of high-strength steel joined by cross-members; cast nodes at high-stress points; rear horns carry the body pivot pins.
ht_frame.material: High-strength low-alloy steel; cast steel nodes.
ht_frame.operating_conditions: Fatigue loading on rough haul roads.
failure_modes: Fatigue cracks at welds and cross-member joints
inspection: Frame crack inspection (visual/MPI) at service intervals

ht_tyre.function: Supports the ~163 t gross machine and gives traction; the tyres are the largest operating cost after fuel and labour.
ht_tyre.construction: Radial OTR tyres (27.00R49 class, ~2.7 m diameter) on five-piece rims (rim base, bead seat band, flanges, lock ring); rear duals.
ht_tyre.material: Rubber compounds with steel-cord carcass; steel rims.
ht_tyre.operating_conditions: Inflation ~6.5–7 bar cold (nitrogen recommended); limited by the tonne-km-per-hour (TKPH) rating.
failure_modes: Heat separation when TKPH is exceeded
inspection: Never stand in line with the rim/lock-ring (sidewall) during inflation or deflation; inflate in a cage or with a remote inflator

ht_suspension.function: Cushions the frame and gives ride comfort and tyre load sharing; steering turns the front wheels.
ht_suspension.construction: Self-contained nitrogen-over-oil suspension cylinders (struts) at each front wheel and two at the rear axle (mounted to the frame kick-up); rear axle located by an A-frame with a centre ball joint and a lateral (panhard) link; strut pressures feed the payload monitor; hydraulic steering cylinders and tie rod.
ht_suspension.material: Steel, chrome-plated rods, nitrogen and oil.
ht_suspension.operating_conditions: Charge height and pressure set to the manufacturer chart.

ht_engine.function: Produces the driving power (~750 kW class).
ht_engine.construction: V12 four-stroke diesel, about 32 L displacement, twin turbochargers and air-to-air aftercooling; electronic unit injection.
ht_engine.operating_conditions: Rated speed ~1,750 rpm; fuel use roughly 60–110 L/h depending on haul profile (engineering estimate).
failure_modes: Dust ingestion through damaged air cleaners

ht_radiator.function: Rejects engine and retarder heat to the air.
ht_radiator.construction: Modular core radiator, hydraulically or engine-driven fan, shroud, front grill.
ht_radiator.operating_conditions: Retarding on long downhill hauls loads the cooling system heavily.

ht_transmission.function: Selects gear ratios so the engine stays in its best speed range.
ht_transmission.construction: Torque converter with lock-up clutch feeding a 7-speed planetary powershift transmission; drive shaft with universal joints to the differential.
ht_transmission.operating_conditions: Electronic clutch pressure control; automatic shifting.

ht_axle.function: Divides torque between the rear wheels and multiplies it; brakes and retards the truck.
ht_axle.construction: Differential and bevel gear set; planetary final drive in each wheel; oil-cooled multiple-disc service/retarder brakes at the rear (spring-applied, hydraulically released parking brake); dry-disc caliper service brakes on the front wheels; brake cooling oil passes through oil-to-water coolers to the radiator.
ht_axle.material: Steel gears, friction discs running in cooled oil.
ht_axle.operating_conditions: Brakes double as the retarder on downhill hauls (oil cooled).
failure_modes: Brake oil overheating on long descents

ht_hood.function: Encloses and protects the engine; doors give service access.
ht_hood.construction: Formed sheet-steel enclosure with louvres and hinged doors.

ht_deck.function: Safe access to the cab and service points; carries air cleaners, exhaust and lights.
ht_deck.construction: Grated upper deck with handrails, diagonal front stairway (≈ 40°), air cleaners, muffler, LED work lights and mirrors.
ht_deck.operating_conditions: Three points of contact on stairs; walk only on the deck.

ht_cab.construction: ROPS/FOPS certified, pressurised, air-conditioned cab on the left of the deck; seat with belt, steering wheel, dash and monitoring display.
inspection: Check door seals and pressuriser filter

ht_tanks.function: Store fuel and hydraulic oil; batteries for starting.
ht_tanks.construction: Fuel tank on the left frame rail; hoist/brake/steering hydraulic tank on the right with sight glass; lockable battery box.

ht_body.function: Carries the payload and tips it out at the dump point.
ht_body.construction: Welded high-hardness steel body with flat floor and tail chute, side ribs, front canopy extending over the cab (protects it while loading) and rock ejectors that knock stones from between the rear duals.
ht_body.material: Abrasion-resistant (≈ 400–500 HB) plate liners on the floor.
ht_body.operating_conditions: Heaped (2:1) capacity about 60–65 m³; dump angle about 45–50°.

ht_payload.construction: About 90 t per load (≈ 60–64 m³ at ~1.4–1.5 t/m³ loose — the body is close to full heaped capacity, so bauxite haulage tends to be volume-limited; body volume/sideboards are selected for the ore density).
ht_payload.operating_conditions: Over-loading beyond the 10/10/20 rule shortens frame and tyre life.
failure_modes: Spillage onto the road → tyre cuts

ht_hoist.construction: Two telescopic hoist cylinders (barrel on the frame, top stage on the body), fed by the hoist pump and a pilot-operated hoist valve with RAISE, HOLD, FLOAT and LOWER positions.
ht_hoist.operating_conditions: Raise time ≈ 12–15 s, lower ≈ 10–14 s (class typical); travel with the lever in FLOAT so the body rests on the frame pads.
failure_modes: Bent stage if dumping on a side slope
inspection: Never travel with the body raised
Body safety pin/cable when working under a raised body
